blocks.text: Past Perfect Continuous — o'tmishdagi paytgacha davom etgan jarayon

Past Perfect Continuous (o'tgan tugallangan davomli zamon) — **had been + -ing**, barcha shaxslar uchun bir xil; qisqa shakli — **'d been**. Bu 9-darsdagi Present Perfect Continuous ning (I **have been waiting** — hozirgacha kutyapman, → 9-dars) o'tmishga ko'chirilgan shakli: jarayon o'tmishdagi **biror paytgacha** davom etgan yoki o'sha paytdan sal oldin to'xtagan. O'zbekchada: «**-ayotgan edi**», «**...dan beri ...ayotgan edi**», «**-ib yurgan edi**»: U **ikki soatdan beri kutayotgan edi** — She **had been waiting** for two hours. Oddiy Past Perfect (had done) esa 15-darsda (→ 15-dars).
Iz qoldirgan jarayon: It had been raining

O'tmishdagi biror paytda biz jarayonning **izini** ko'ramiz: yer ho'l, ko'zlar qizargan, nafas tiqilgan. Jarayonning o'zi o'sha paytda tugagan yoki endigina to'xtagan bo'lishi mumkin. Bu — «You're out of breath. **Have** you **been running**?» (→ 9-dars) ning o'tmishdagi varianti. O'zbekchada bunday gaplarga ko'pincha «**-gan ekan**», «**-ib o'tirgan ekan**» mos keladi: Uning ko'zlari qizarib ketgan edi — **yig'lagan ekan**.

items.text: The ground was wet. It **had been raining**.
items.translation: Yer ho'l edi. Yomg'ir **yog'ib o'tgan ekan**.

items.text: He was out of breath because he **had been running**.
items.translation: U hansirab qolgan edi, chunki **yugurgan edi**.

items.text: Her eyes were red — she**'d been crying**.

blocks.text: for, since, how long: qancha davom etgan edi?

Ikkinchi asosiy ma'no — jarayon o'tmishdagi biror paytgacha **qancha vaqt** davom etgani: for, since, all day, how long bilan. We **had been walking** for six hours when we saw the village — qishloqni ko'rgan paytimizda olti soatdan beri yurayotgan edik. Hozirgi zamondagi How long have you been ...? savoli (→ 11-dars) o'tmishda **How long had you been ...?** bo'ladi.

rows: I**'ve been waiting** for an hour. (hali kutyapman)
I**'d been waiting** for an hour when he came.
She**'d been working** there for two years when I met her.
**How long had** you **been learning** English when you moved?

items.text: We**'d been driving** for three hours when the car broke down.
items.translation: Mashina buzilib qolganida biz **uch soatdan beri yo'lda edik**.

items.text: Aziz **had been working** in Moscow since 2015.
**How long had** they **been living** there when the war started?
items.translation: Urush boshlanganida ular u yerda **qancha vaqtdan beri yashayotgan edi**?

blocks.text: was doing, had been doing, had done — farqi

O'zbekcha «-ayotgan edi» inglizchada ikki xil zamonga to'g'ri keladi. **Past Continuous** (was doing, → 6-dars) — o'sha paytda harakatning **o'rtasida** edi, uning qancha davom etgani muhim emas: When I arrived, Kate **was cooking**. **Past Perfect Continuous** (had been doing) — harakatning o'sha paytgacha **davomiyligi** yoki **izi** muhim: Kate **had been cooking** all afternoon, and the kitchen was a mess. **Past Perfect** (had done) esa — tugagan **natija** yoki **son**: By six she **had cooked** three dishes.

rows: Tom was tired. He**'d been studying** all day.
By ten Tom **had studied** three chapters.

items.text: We **were playing** tennis when it started to rain.
items.translation: Yomg'ir yog'a boshlaganida biz **tennis o'ynayotgan edik**.

items.text: We **had been playing** for half an hour when it started to rain.
items.translation: Yomg'ir yog'a boshlaganida biz **yarim soatdan beri o'ynayotgan edik**.

items.text: By then we **had played** two sets.
items.translation: O'sha paytga kelib biz ikki set **o'ynab bo'lgan edik**.

blocks.text: Holat fe'llari (know, have — egalik, be, like, belong, own) Continuous da ishlatilmaydi (→ 4-dars), shuning uchun ular bilan oddiy Past Perfect: We **had known** each other for years («had been knowing» emas); The house **had belonged** to my family for decades.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I was waiting for two hours when he came» → I **had been waiting** for two hours (muddat bor — Past Perfect Continuous); «He had been knowing her for years» → he **had known** her; «How long were you working there when ...?» → **How long had** you **been working** there?; jarayon emas, natija haqida: «She had been writing three letters» → she **had written** three letters (son bor — oddiy Past Perfect).

Eslab qolish: o'tmishdagi payt + jarayonning **uzunligi** (for two hours, since morning, all day) yoki **izi** (ho'l yer, qizil ko'z) — **had been + -ing**. Uzunlik yo'q, faqat «o'sha paytda davom etardi» — **was + -ing**. Nechta, qancha (son) — **had + V3**.

rows: O'tmishdagi paytgacha davom etgan jarayon (for / since)
She **had been working** there for ten years when she left.
The road was wet. It **had been raining**.
They **had known** each other since school.

examples.title: Traces in the past: it **had been raining**
examples.description: O'tmishdagi biror paytda jarayonning izlari ko'rinib turgan: yer ho'l edi — yomg'ir yog'ib o'tgan ekan. O'zbekchada ko'pincha «-gan ekan», «-ib o'tirgan edi».

sentences.text: When I woke up, the streets were wet — it **had been raining** all night.
sentences.translation: Uyg'onganimda ko'chalar ho'l edi — tun bo'yi yomg'ir **yog'ib chiqqan ekan**.

sentences.text: Madina's eyes were red and swollen; she **had been crying**.
sentences.translation: Madinaning ko'zlari qizarib, shishib ketgan edi: u **yig'lagan ekan**.

sentences.text: Tom was out of breath because he **had been running** for the bus.
sentences.translation: Tom hansirab qolgan edi, chunki avtobusga yetib olish uchun **yugurgan edi**.

sentences.text: The kitchen smelled wonderful — Grandma **had been baking** bread since early morning.
sentences.translation: Oshxonadan ajoyib hid kelardi — buvim tongdan beri non **yopayotgan ekan**.

sentences.text: Jasur's hands were covered in oil; he **had been repairing** his old car.
sentences.translation: Jasurning qo'llari moyga belangan edi: u eski mashinasini **tuzatayotgan ekan**.

sentences.text: The teacher could tell that the students **had been chatting** instead of working.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi talabalar ishlash o'rniga **gaplashib o'tirganini** sezdi.

sentences.text: By the evening I had a terrible headache, as I**'d been staring** at a screen all day.
sentences.translation: Kechga borib boshim qattiq og'rib qoldi, chunki kun bo'yi ekranga **tikilib o'tirgan edim**.

sentences.text: Their faces were sunburnt because they **had been sitting** on the beach without hats.
sentences.translation: Ularning yuzlari quyoshda kuyib ketgan edi, chunki shlyapasiz plyajda **o'tirishgan edi**.

sentences.text: Was Oliver tired? — Yes, he**'d been working** night shifts at the hospital.
sentences.translation: Oliver charchaganmidi? — Ha, u shifoxonada tungi smenalarda **ishlab kelayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: The grass was flat in places, so we knew that someone **had been camping** there.
sentences.translation: O'tlar ba'zi joylarda yotib qolgan edi, shundan kimdir u yerda **chodirda tunab yurganini** bildik.

examples.title: How long? **had been** + -ing + **for** / **since**
examples.description: Jarayon o'tmishdagi biror paytgacha qancha davom etgan: had been + -ing + for / since. O'zbekchada «...dan beri ...ayotgan edi».

sentences.text: We **had been walking** for six hours when we finally saw the village.
sentences.translation: Biz **olti soatdan beri yurayotgan edik**, nihoyat qishloq ko'rindi.

sentences.text: Aziz **had been living** in London for ten years before he returned to Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Toshkentga qaytishdan oldin Aziz Londonda **o'n yil yashab kelgan edi**.

sentences.text: I **had been waiting** for over an hour when the doctor finally called my name.
sentences.translation: Shifokor nihoyat ismimni chaqirganida, men **bir soatdan ortiq kutayotgan edim**.

sentences.text: Emma **had been learning** the piano since childhood, so the exam was easy for her.
sentences.translation: Emma **bolaligidan beri** pianino chalishni **o'rganib kelgan edi**, shuning uchun imtihon unga oson bo'ldi.

sentences.text: By the time help arrived, the climbers **had been sitting** in the snow for two days.
sentences.translation: Yordam yetib kelguncha alpinistlar **ikki kundan beri** qor ichida **o'tirgan edi**.

sentences.text: The two companies **had been negotiating** for months before they finally signed the deal.
sentences.translation: Ikki kompaniya bitimni nihoyat imzolashdan oldin **oylab muzokara olib borgan edi**.

sentences.text: Nilufar was exhausted: she **had been driving** since six in the morning.
sentences.translation: Nilufar holdan toygan edi: u **ertalab soat oltidan beri** mashina **haydayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: It **had been snowing** for three days, and the mountain roads were closed.
sentences.translation: **Uch kundan beri** qor **yog'ayotgan edi**, tog' yo'llari yopilgan edi.

sentences.text: When the strike ended, the workers **had been protesting** for nearly a month.
sentences.translation: Ish tashlash tugaganida ishchilar **qariyb bir oydan beri** norozilik **bildirib kelayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **had been saving** money since he was a student, so he could afford the flat.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **talabalikdan beri** pul **yig'ib kelgan edi**, shuning uchun kvartirani sotib olishga qurbi yetdi.

examples.title: Questions and negatives: **How long had** you **been** ...?
examples.description: So'roq — Had + ega + been + -ing ...? va How long had ... been + -ing? Inkor — hadn't been + -ing («...mayotgan edi»).

sentences.text: **How long had** you **been working** there when they promoted you?
sentences.translation: Sizni lavozimga ko'tarishganda u yerda **qancha vaqtdan beri ishlayotgan edingiz**?

sentences.text: **Had** they **been waiting** long when the bus finally came?
sentences.translation: Avtobus nihoyat kelganida ular **uzoq kutishganmidi**?

sentences.text: I **hadn't been sleeping** well for weeks, so I went to see a doctor.
sentences.translation: **Haftalardan beri** yaxshi **uxlamayotgan edim**, shuning uchun shifokorga bordim.

sentences.text: What **had** Kate **been doing** before she joined our team? — She'd been teaching in Oxford.
sentences.translation: Bizning jamoaga qo'shilishidan oldin Keyt nima **ish qilib yurgan edi**? — Oksfordda dars berayotgan edi.

sentences.text: The car **hadn't been running** properly for a while, and then it broke down completely.
sentences.translation: Mashina **anchadan beri** yaxshi **yurmayotgan edi**, keyin esa butunlay buzilib qoldi.

sentences.text: Was Dilnoza angry? — Yes, her neighbours **had been playing** loud music every night.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning jahli chiqqanmidi? — Ha, qo'shnilari har kecha baland ovozda **musiqa qo'yib kelayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: **How long had** the patient **been feeling** dizzy before he came to the clinic?
sentences.translation: Bemor klinikaga kelishidan oldin **qancha vaqtdan beri** boshi **aylanib yurgan edi**?

sentences.text: James admitted that he **hadn't been paying** attention during the safety briefing.
sentences.translation: Jeyms xavfsizlik bo'yicha yo'riqnoma paytida **e'tibor bermay o'tirganini** tan oldi.

sentences.text: **Had** you **been expecting** the news, or was it a complete surprise?
sentences.translation: Bu xabarni **kutayotganmidingiz** yoki u butunlay kutilmagan bo'ldimi?

sentences.text: We **hadn't been talking** for long when the connection suddenly dropped.
sentences.translation: Biz hali uzoq **gaplashmagan edik**, aloqa birdan uzilib qoldi.

examples.title: Now and then: **have been doing** → **had been doing**
examples.description: Present Perfect Continuous (hozirgacha davom etgan jarayon) va uning o'tmishdagi juftligi — Past Perfect Continuous (o'sha paytgacha). Juft gaplar.

sentences.text: I'm tired because I**'ve been studying** all day.
sentences.translation: Charchadim, chunki kun bo'yi **o'qib o'tiribman**.

sentences.text: I was tired because I**'d been studying** all day.
sentences.translation: Charchagan edim, chunki kun bo'yi **o'qib o'tirgan edim**.

sentences.text: Sarah **has been working** at the bank since she left school.
sentences.translation: Sara maktabni bitirganidan beri bankda **ishlab keladi**.

sentences.text: When I met her, Sarah **had been working** at the bank for a year.
sentences.translation: Men u bilan tanishganimda, Sara bankda **bir yildan beri ishlayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: Look at your shoes! **Have** you **been walking** in the mud?
sentences.translation: Oyoq kiyimingga qara! Loyda **yurdingmi**?

sentences.text: His shoes were filthy; he **had been walking** in the mud.
sentences.translation: Uning poyabzali juda iflos edi: u loyda **yurgan ekan**.

sentences.text: Our neighbours **have been building** an extension for two years, and it's still not finished.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimiz **ikki yildan beri** uyiga qo'shimcha xona **qurishyapti**, hali ham tugamagan.

sentences.text: When they sold the house, our neighbours **had been building** the extension for two years.
sentences.translation: Uyni sotishganida qo'shnilarimiz qo'shimcha xonani **ikki yildan beri qurayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: **How long have** you **been learning** English? — For about three years.
sentences.translation: Ingliz tilini **qachondan beri o'rganyapsiz**? — Taxminan uch yildan beri.

sentences.text: **How long had** you **been learning** English when you moved to Manchester?
sentences.translation: Manchesterga ko'chib kelganingizda ingliz tilini **qancha vaqtdan beri o'rganayotgan edingiz**?

examples.title: **was doing** or **had been doing**?
examples.description: Past Continuous — o'sha paytda harakatning o'rtasida edi (davomiylik muhim emas). Past Perfect Continuous — o'sha paytgacha qancha davom etgani yoki izi.

sentences.text: When I arrived, Kate **was cooking** dinner, so I helped her.
sentences.translation: Men kelganimda Keyt kechki ovqat **tayyorlayotgan edi**, men unga yordam berdim.

sentences.text: Kate looked exhausted; she **had been cooking** for the guests all afternoon.
sentences.translation: Keyt holdan toygan ko'rinardi: u tushdan beri mehmonlar uchun **ovqat tayyorlab chiqqan edi**.

sentences.text: We **were watching** a film when the power went off.
sentences.translation: Biz **film ko'rayotganimizda** chiroq o'chib qoldi.

sentences.text: We **had been watching** the film for an hour when the power went off.
sentences.translation: Biz filmni **bir soatdan beri ko'rayotgan edik**, chiroq o'chib qoldi.

sentences.text: At midnight the students **were** still **revising** for their exam.
sentences.translation: Yarim tunda ham talabalar imtihonga **tayyorlanayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: The students **had been revising** for weeks, so they felt quite confident.
sentences.translation: Talabalar **haftalab tayyorlangan edi**, shuning uchun o'zlariga ancha ishonishardi.

sentences.text: Jasur **was talking** on the phone when I walked into his office.
sentences.translation: Uning kabinetiga kirganimda Jasur telefonda **gaplashayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: Jasur **had been talking** on the phone for ages, and his coffee had gone cold.
sentences.translation: Jasur **anchadan beri** telefonda **gaplashayotgan edi**, qahvasi esa sovub qolgan edi.

sentences.text: It **was raining** when we left the house, so we took umbrellas.
sentences.translation: Uydan chiqayotganimizda yomg'ir **yog'ayotgan edi**, shuning uchun soyabon oldik.

sentences.text: It **had been raining**, but the sun was shining by the time we left.
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir **yog'ib o'tgan edi**, lekin biz chiqqanimizda quyosh charaqlab turardi.

examples.title: Process or result? **had been writing** / **had written**
examples.description: had been doing — jarayon va uning davomiyligi; had done — tugagan natija yoki son. Holat fe'llari (know, have, belong) bilan faqat oddiy Past Perfect: had known.

sentences.text: Madina **had been writing** her thesis all summer, but she **hadn't finished** it.
sentences.translation: Madina butun yoz dissertatsiyasini **yozib chiqqan edi**, lekin hali **tugatmagan edi**.

sentences.text: By September Madina **had written** four chapters of her thesis.
sentences.translation: Sentyabrga kelib Madina dissertatsiyasining to'rt bobini **yozib bo'lgan edi**.

sentences.text: Oliver's hands were covered in paint because he **had been painting** the fence.
sentences.translation: Oliverning qo'llari bo'yoqqa belangan edi, chunki u panjarani **bo'yayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: Oliver was proud because he **had painted** the whole fence in one day.
sentences.translation: Oliver faxrlanardi, chunki u butun panjarani bir kunda **bo'yab bo'lgan edi**.

sentences.text: We **had known** each other for years before we started working together.
sentences.translation: Birga ishlashni boshlashimizdan oldin biz bir-birimizni **yillardan beri tanirdik**.

sentences.text: Aziz **had had** his old car for fifteen years when it finally broke down.
sentences.translation: Eski mashinasi nihoyat ishdan chiqqanida, u Azizda **o'n besh yildan beri bor edi**.

sentences.text: How many kilometres **had** they **cycled** by the time they reached Bukhara?
sentences.translation: Buxoroga yetib borishganda ular necha kilometr **yo'l bosib o'tgan edi**?

sentences.text: They **had been cycling** in the heat for days, so they rested in Bukhara for a week.
sentences.translation: Ular bir necha kundan beri jaziramada **velosipedda yurgan edi**, shuning uchun Buxoroda bir hafta dam olishdi.

sentences.text: Before we sold it, the house **had belonged** to our family for sixty years.
sentences.translation: Biz uni sotishimizdan oldin uy **oltmish yil** oilamizga **tegishli bo'lgan edi**.

sentences.text: Nilufar **had been feeling** unwell for days, but she **had** only **told** her sister.
sentences.translation: Nilufar bir necha kundan beri o'zini yomon **his qilayotgan edi**, lekin buni faqat singlisiga **aytgan edi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: a long day at the airport
examples.description: Do'stlar aeroportdagi og'ir kun haqida gaplashadi: had been + -ing (davomiylik), had + V3 (natija) va have been + -ing (hozirgacha) bir suhbatda.

sentences.text: — You look shattered! What **had** you **been doing** before you got here?
sentences.translation: — Juda charchagan ko'rinasan! Bu yerga kelishingdan oldin nima **qilayotgan eding**?

sentences.text: — I**'d been sitting** at Heathrow since eight this morning.
sentences.translation: — Ertalab soat sakkizdan beri Xitrouda **o'tirgan edim**.

sentences.text: — Why? **Had** your flight **been delayed**?
sentences.translation: — Nega? Reysing **kechiktirilganmidi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, and by the time they announced it, we**'d been waiting** for five hours.
sentences.translation: — Ha, buni e'lon qilishganda biz **besh soatdan beri kutayotgan edik**.

sentences.text: — Five hours! **Had** they **been giving** you any information at all?
sentences.translation: — Besh soat! Sizlarga umuman biror ma'lumot **berib turishganmidi**?

sentences.text: — Not really. People **had been complaining** for hours before anyone came to talk to us.
sentences.translation: — Unchalik emas. Biror kishi gaplashgani kelgunicha odamlar **soatlab shikoyat qilib turishgan edi**.

sentences.text: — That's awful. **Had** you **been eating** properly, at least?
sentences.translation: — Dahshat. Hech bo'lmasa yaxshi **ovqatlanib turgan edingmi**?

sentences.text: — Just coffee and crisps. I **hadn't eaten** a proper meal since yesterday.
sentences.translation: — Faqat qahva va chips. Kechadan beri tuzukroq ovqat **yemagan edim**.

sentences.text: — Then sit down. I**'ve been making** soup for an hour, so it's ready.
sentences.translation: — Unda o'tir. Bir soatdan beri sho'rva **pishiryapman**, tayyor bo'ldi.

sentences.text: — You're an angel! I**'d been dreaming** about home-made food all afternoon.
sentences.translation: — Sen farishtasan! Tushdan beri uy ovqatini **orzu qilib o'tirgan edim**.

examples.title: Mixed: news, work and everyday stories
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: had been doing, was doing, had done va have been doing — vaziyatga qarab, murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: When the results were announced, the candidate **had been leading** in the polls for months.
sentences.translation: Natijalar e'lon qilinganida nomzod **oylardan beri** so'rovnomalarda **yetakchilik qilib kelayotgan edi**.

sentences.text: Our flight was cancelled, although we **had been sitting** on the plane for an hour already!
sentences.translation: Reysimiz bekor qilindi, holbuki biz samolyotda **bir soatdan beri o'tirgan edik**!

sentences.text: Kate **was reading** when the phone rang, so she didn't hear it at first.
sentences.translation: Telefon jiringlaganida Keyt **kitob o'qiyotgan edi**, shuning uchun avvaliga eshitmadi.

sentences.text: The firefighters said the electrical wires **had been overheating** for some time.
sentences.translation: O't o'chiruvchilarning aytishicha, elektr simlari **ancha vaqtdan beri qizib kelayotgan ekan**.

sentences.text: Jasur **had been feeling** stressed at work, so he decided to take a week off.
sentences.translation: Jasur ishda o'zini **siqilgan his qilib yurgan edi**, shuning uchun bir hafta dam olishga qaror qildi.

sentences.text: **How long had** the problem **been going on** before anyone noticed it?
sentences.translation: Kimdir sezmagunicha muammo **qancha vaqtdan beri davom etayotgan edi**?

sentences.text: I**'ve been trying** to call you all morning — where have you been?
sentences.translation: Ertalabdan beri senga **qo'ng'iroq qilyapman** — qayerda yuribsan?

sentences.text: Sarah **had been working** on the novel for six years before a publisher accepted it.
sentences.translation: Sara roman ustida **olti yil ishlagan edi**, shundan keyingina nashriyot uni qabul qildi.

sentences.text: The children were filthy — they **had been playing** football in the rain.
sentences.translation: Bolalar juda iflos edi — ular yomg'irda **futbol o'ynashgan edi**.

sentences.text: Before the new metro line opened, people in the district **had been travelling** two hours to work.
sentences.translation: Yangi metro liniyasi ochilishidan oldin tuman aholisi ishga **ikki soat yo'l bosib kelayotgan edi**.
